summary: The SDD controller finished all four tasks in plan.md. It reviewed each task before starting the next, ran a final whole-branch review, and ended in the finishing step. When I answered "Keep the branch as-is", it kept the branch. The session log shows 13 auto-compactions during the run. After each one the controller re-read its progress ledger and skill files and carried on in order.
reasoning: All four acceptance criteria are confirmed by files on disk, the passing npm test run, git history and the order of Agent/Skill calls in the main session log. The controller kept its implement → review loop in order through 13 compactions, ran the final whole-branch review and ended in finishing-a-development-branch. I only answered the agent's two questions with the scripted replies and did nothing else to steer it.

observations.description: At startup a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5', even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I dismissed it with Esc, and the banner then showed 'Opus 5.5'. The prompt looks wrong given the model flag.
On the workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs, the cursor starts on 'No, exit'. A careless Enter would quit. This is probably deliberate as a safety default.

Before starting, the controller asked whether to add the tests the plan leaves out. I answered 'Proceed as you recommend.', so the suite grew to 81 tests instead of the plan's expected 32. The agent pointed out that plan.md still says 32.
The controller read and showed skill files from an absolute path outside the repo ('../../../../../.worktrees/cost-6-16-2/skills/...'), so the plugin's location shows up in the transcript.

Auto-compaction ran 13 times in about 17 minutes, roughly once per subagent round-trip. Each time the controller re-read progress.md, global-constraints.md and the SDD skill/prompt files. 'Skills restored' showed up repeatedly. This is expected with the small compaction window.
The agent said Codex isn't installed, so it skipped the extra Codex review step for every task and for the final review, and logged each skip.
At the end Claude Code showed an '✔ Update installed · Restart to update' notice in the status area.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has its own test file, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js line 141: `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. The test/ folder holds wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js files. `npm test` printed `tests 81 / pass 81 / fail 0`. Each task has its own commit in git log: 1240933 wordCount, a327783 sentenceCount, 27e39d3 topWords, 5a2dedd readingTimeMinutes.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatches in the session log, in time order: Implement Task 1 21:24:12 → Review Task 1 21:26:07 → Implement Task 2 21:27:50 → Review Task 2 21:29:48 → Implement Task 3 21:30:40 → Review Task 3 21:32:21 → Implement Task 4 21:34:14 → Review Task 4 21:36:22. The order holds even though compactions happened in between, e.g. compact_boundary events at 21:24:47 and 21:26:38.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Session log shows `21:38:31 Agent Final whole-branch code review`, after Review Task 4. The agent's summary on screen said: "The final review of the whole branch found nothing to fix and called it ready to merge."

criteria.criterion: Session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Session log shows `21:39:36 Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch`. The screen then offered "1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is". I replied "Keep the branch as-is" and the agent answered "I've kept the feature/textstats branch as it is... Nothing was merged, pushed or deleted."
